name: NF-02/NF-09 optional policy and empty recommendation catalogue; NF-21 boundary preparation

files_create.purpose: Canonical optionality, authority, artifact-class and missing-tool decision table; no duplicated workflow policy.
Nizam-owned catalogue v1.0 schema with exact recommended pins and evidence; local-only references.
Versioned empty catalogue with no active recommendation or external lookup.
Offline schema positive and negative controls only; no resolver execution or copied DS contracts.
Approved narrow public metadata inventory, private execution/log rules, attestation requirements and missing DS-01 gate.
Minimal external-artifact receipt index with unavailable identities represented honestly, no private source content.

files_modify.purpose: Index the optional policy, catalogue schema and empty catalogue under their distinct authorities.
Route to optional policy without granting authorization or weakening selected checks.

non_goals: No resolver, execution, installation, remote discovery, workflow mutation, permission change, recommendation activation or release.
No installed .nizam edits, portable DS contract invention, private schema/fixture/source/transcript publication or counterpart edits.
No claim that publication approval supplies DS-01 ownership acceptance, trusted attestation, exact artifacts or behavioral qualification.

acceptance_requirements.requirement: Absent, declined, incompatible, unsupported, compatible and broken explicitly adopted policy states preserve generic use and distinguish selected required checks; no automatic installation/adoption or broad NDS frontmatter imposition.

Empty catalogue validates; lifecycle is candidate/verified/recommended/withdrawn, separate from local availability; exact source commit and inventory digest, supported neutral contract versions, framework scope and qualification evidence required to recommend.
Catalogue metadata grants no permission; validation is local and has no external package/network prerequisite; public entries include only approved metadata/acquisition instruction references.

Inventory records owner approval received for exact metadata categories, authorized private acquisition/execution and raw artifact retention; no private sources copied; DS-01 remains unaccepted until supplied actual bytes/identity.
Index exposes policy, schema and empty catalogue distinctly; interface refers to policy, no capability grants authorization and no remote lookup introduced.

verification.command: Focused source review of decision table and item-by-item publication inventory against supplied NF-02/NF-21 acceptance and user approval; write .agent/evidence/nf-optional-policy/source-review.json

evidence_convention: Exclusive start_path captures for commands; source-review.json records checked requirements and limitations without private content.
role_allocation: Standard: child combines Planner/Generator/Validator, parent independently reviews contract and implementation. This contract describes authority boundaries but changes no authority verification mechanism.
prerequisite_disposition: NF-01 intake recorded by parent; NF-21 cannot be complete without accepted DS-01. NF-09 begins with empty catalogue only.
